clips.prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
At night on a narrow festival street, a girl loses her younger brother into a moving crowd while both remain on the stall-side of the same screen axis.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
@image1: 10-year-old girl, slight build, straight black bob with blunt bangs, large dark-brown eyes, small mole under left eye, red-and-white goldfish yukata, fox-faced paper lantern in her left hand. 100% matches the reference.
@image2: the same girl in three-quarter view. 100% matches the reference.
@image3: the lantern-lit festival street and fixed stall geometry. 100% matches the reference.
@image4: the occupied opening composition and character positions. 100% matches the reference.
@image5: the final close composition on the girl. 100% matches the reference.
@audio1: the girl's locked speaking voice. 100% matches the reference.

LOCATION MAP
Foreground lantern glow crosses the lower frame; the girl stands center-left in the midground beside the stall front; the boy begins at her camera-right hand and moves deeper frame-right through the crowd; banners and indigo sky layer the background. Warm light originates at the stalls on camera-right.

FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING
The girl is already turning from the stall as the boy pulls her right arm toward frame-right; her lantern hangs from her left hand. Both faces are visible and their feet remain on the same side of the stall-front axis.

FORMAT MODE
One continuous shot, the camera does not cut on its own.

OPTICS
MS at 47 degrees, resolving into an MCU without FOV drift. Natural rectilinear perspective and grounded motion blur.

CAMERA
Eye-level on the shadow side, 2 meters from the girl. The operator advances 0.3 meters as she turns, keeps focus on her eyes, and ends with her face filling the center-left of frame.

ACTION
The boy pulls free and moves frame-right at 8 km/h into the crowd. The girl pivots after him, raises her free hand, and stops at the stall edge as bodies close the gap.

PERFORMANCE
The boy's mouth opens in a quick grin as he looks toward the drums. The girl's eyes widen, her lower eyelids tighten, and she draws one short breath before calling after him.

PHYSICS
The tug loads the girl's sleeve before the hands separate; the paper lantern swings with inertia and settles behind her turn; passing shoulders compress fabric and cast contact shadows.

LIGHTING
Warm paper-lantern key from camera-right, cool night rim from camera-left, fixed 4000K white balance, readable catchlights, and haze visible at 12 meters.

AUDIO
The boy says: "Look, the drums! I want to see!" The girl says: "Kenji, wait -- stay close!" Festival drums and crowd murmur rise as he disappears.

STYLE
Painterly family-film finish with tactile paper, fabric, wood, restrained fine grain, and living facial detail.

OUTPUT SETTINGS
16:9, 1080p, real-time motion for the full shot.

POSITIVE LOCKS
The girl's bob, mole, yukata, and lantern remain unchanged. The lantern stays in her left hand. The stall remains camera-left of the boy's path. The shot stays continuous and the camera preserves the stall-front axis.
